title: US-0: Setup projet (scaffolding, CLAUDE.md, CI basique)

tasks.title: Create CLAUDE.md
tasks.description: Create the root CLAUDE.md file describing the project, tech stack, repository layout, coding conventions, and common commands for both backend and frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: CLAUDE.md exists at repository root
Contains project description: bookmark manager with tags, single-user, no auth
Lists tech stack: FastAPI (Python 3.12), React/Vite (JS, Node 20), SQLite/SQLAlchemy (dev), PostgreSQL (prod)
Documents monorepo layout with backend/ and frontend/ directories
Documents coding conventions: Ruff for Python, ESLint for JS
Lists common commands per sub-project: dev server, test, lint, build

tasks.title: Scaffold backend (FastAPI)
tasks.description: Create the backend/ directory with a Python/FastAPI project structure. Includes pyproject.toml with dependencies and tool configs, a minimal FastAPI app with /health endpoint, and a test for the health endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/pyproject.toml exists with project metadata, dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn[standard]), optional dev deps (pytest, httpx, ruff), ruff config (line-length=88), and pytest config
backend/app/__init__.py exists (package marker)
backend/app/main.py exists with FastAPI app and GET /health returning {"status": "ok"}
backend/tests/__init__.py exists (package marker)
backend/tests/test_health.py exists using TestClient to assert /health returns 200 and correct JSON body
Running `cd backend && pip install -e '.[dev]' && pytest` passes
Running `cd backend && ruff check . && ruff format --check .` passes

tasks.title: Scaffold frontend (React/Vite)
tasks.description: Create the frontend/ directory with a React/Vite project structure. Includes package.json with scripts and dependencies, Vite config, ESLint flat config, HTML entry point, minimal React app, and a component test.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/package.json exists with scripts (dev, build, preview, test, lint) and correct dependencies (react, react-dom) and devDependencies (vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, vitest, eslint, eslint-plugin-react, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom)
frontend/vite.config.js exists with React plugin and Vitest test environment (jsdom)
frontend/eslint.config.js exists using ESLint 9+ flat config format with react plugin
frontend/index.html exists as HTML entry point referencing src/main.jsx
frontend/src/main.jsx exists bootstrapping React app
frontend/src/App.jsx exists rendering a minimal component with the app name
frontend/tests/App.test.jsx exists rendering App and checking for text presence
Running `cd frontend && npm install && npm test` passes
Running `cd frontend && npm run lint` passes
Running `cd frontend && npm run build` passes

tasks.title: Create CI pipeline
tasks.description: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs lint and tests for both backend and frontend on push and pull_request events. Two parallel jobs: backend (Python 3.12) and frontend (Node 20).
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml exists and is valid YAML
Triggers on push and pull_request on all branches
Backend job uses Python 3.12, installs via pip install -e '.[dev]', runs ruff check, ruff format --check, and pytest
Frontend job uses Node 20, installs via npm ci, runs npm run lint and npm test
Both jobs run in parallel (no dependency between them)
Uses actions/setup-python and actions/setup-node with caching enabled

tasks.title: Update .gitignore
tasks.description: Expand the existing .gitignore to cover both Python and Node stacks more thoroughly, plus common IDE directories.
acceptanceCriteria: .gitignore includes Python entries: .ruff_cache/, *.egg-info/, .pytest_cache/, .venv/
.gitignore includes Node entries: build/, .vite/, coverage/
.gitignore includes IDE entries: .vscode/, .idea/
Existing entries (__pycache__/, *.py[cod], .env, venv/, node_modules/, dist/) are preserved
